infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the The Labyrinth transit on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Knossos LLC facility key (Knossos) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A worn office door key marked "Knossos LLC". Probably used to open utility rooms or other premises belonging to Knossos.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in the quest Offensive Reconnaissance
- Used in the quest Hidden Layer

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In different locations at the health resort on Shoreline. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: In the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline.
